summary: Reviewed WP-009 scope: run_logger parameter added to _accumulate_stream() (src/nodes/__init__.py); TestStageRetryLogEntry added to tests/test_stream_retry.py (5 tests). All OWASP Top 10 categories reviewed. 0 Critical, 0 High, 0 Medium findings. Security sign-off: PASS.

comments.note: No security findings — all OWASP Top 10 categories reviewed; no Critical or High issues identified. WP-009 adds run_logger: Any = None to _accumulate_stream() and emits a stage_retry dict via run_logger.stream_entry() on each retry. The logger object is internal (passed from node_fn() closure), not user-controlled. The if run_logger is not None guard correctly prevents any runtime crash when logging is absent.

Info — 'error': str(_exc) in the stage_retry entry (src/nodes/__init__.py:~530) logs the raw API exception string. JSON serialization by the JSONL writer escapes all special characters, eliminating log injection risk. The run log is a local developer file (orchestrator/logs/). Provider error messages sometimes include contextual data (e.g. rate-limit policy hints); this is standard practice for developer tooling and carries no significant security risk given the local-only target.

summary: Reviewed _accumulate_stream() signature extension (run_logger: Any = None) and stage_retry JSONL emission in src/nodes/__init__.py, plus TestStageRetryLogEntry (5 tests) in tests/test_stream_retry.py.

Implementation is clean: the guard 'if run_logger is not None:' is placed correctly in the retry handler (only reached after a transient error is confirmed, before the sleep). The entry dict includes all required AC2 fields (attempt, error, delay_s) plus enrichments (stage, wp_id, max_attempts, level, timestamp). 'delay_s' uses round(delay, 1) for stable log values.

Test suite covers all three ACs plus both boundary cases (success-without-retry and None logger). Using MagicMock for run_logger and asserting on stream_entry call counts and call_args is idiomatic and precise. No blocking issues found.

comments.note: Minor style note: the new guard 'if run_logger is not None:' (line 529) is slightly inconsistent with existing guards 'if run_logger:' used in _handle_rollback (line 647) and _read_pipeline_result (line 725). Both forms are functionally equivalent for a logger object and 'is not None' is arguably more semantically precise. Not a blocking issue; worth normalising in a future cleanup pass if the team prefers a single idiom throughout the module.

[documentation-forward] The stage_retry JSONL entry (action, stage, wp_id, attempt, max_attempts, error, delay_s, level, timestamp) is a new log entry type added by WP-009 but is not yet documented in the orchestrator log schema reference. The log schema docs should be updated to include the full field list, types, semantics, and an example entry so future log consumers (read-log.js, external tooling) can parse it correctly.
